name: CalculatedMembers
description: A collection of all the CalculatedMember objects on the specified PivotTable.
remarks: Each CalculatedMember object represents a calculated member or calculated measure. Use the CalculatedMembers property of the PivotTable object to return a CalculatedMembers collection. There are three supported types of calculated members: Named Sets, Calculated Members, and Calculated Measures. Object model support has been available for all three types since Excel 2010. User interface support was made available for Named Sets in Excel 2010. In Excel 2013, the OLAP Calculated Members and Calculated Measures feature was created to build a user interface for the calculated members and measures object model. Named Sets is used exactly the same as in Excel 2010. Named Sets should continue to use the Add method, and the type XlCalculatedMemberType enumeration. Calculated Members has the following changes for Excel 2013: - It now uses the AddCalculatedMember method. - It supports the following properties of the CalculatedMember object: - ParentHierarchy property - ParentMember property - NumberFormat property Calculated Measures has the following changes for Excel 2013: - It now uses the AddCalculatedMember method. - It now uses the type XlCalculatedMemberType enumeration.
example:
Sub UseCalculatedMember()
 Dim pvtTable As PivotTable
 Set pvtTable = ActiveSheet.PivotTables(1)
 pvtTable.CalculatedMembers.Add Name:="[Beef]", _
 Formula:="'{[Product].[All Products].Children}'", _
 Type:=xlCalculatedSet

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, Formula As Variant, [SolveOrder As Variant], [Type As Variant], [Dynamic As Variant], [DisplayFolder As Variant], [HierarchizeDistinct As Variant]) As CalculatedMember
methods.description: Adds a calculated field or calculated item to a PivotTable. Returns a CalculatedMember object.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the calculated member.

parameters.name: Formula
parameters.description: The formula of the calculated member.

parameters.name: SolveOrder
parameters.description: The solve order for the calculated member.

parameters.name: Dynamic
parameters.description: Specifies if the calculated member is recalculated with every update.

parameters.name: DisplayFolder
parameters.description: The name of the display folder for the calculated member.

parameters.name: HierarchizeDistinct
parameters.description: Specifies whether to order and remove duplicates when displaying the hierarchy of the calculated member in a PivotTable report based on an OLAP cube.
